note: The rules the weekly build applies, in one place. The tools read these values and the page's 'How this is worked out' footnotes render them, so what the page says and what the build does cannot drift apart. tools/check_consistency.py fails if a value here differs from what the build or the SDWS1 pipeline actually applied.

pipeline.evidence_folder: /mnt/c/Users/bushp/OneDrive - SaniTap/Central Data Hub - Water Documents/Evidence/SDWS1 people served (current method)

maintenance.note: A pump is overdue when its last preventive visit or repair (or, with neither, its commissioning) is more than overdue_after_days old - six months. The visit-age bands on the page split pumps at these edges: under 91 days, 91-182, 183-365, 366 and over.

activity.note: The week counters: activity in the last week_days, the week before it, and the last window_days, counted back from the newest activity date in the extracts.

repairs.note: Time-to-repair shares: the percentage of measured repairs completed within each of these many days of notification.
repairs.target_note: Target (Adriaan Mol, 7 Oct 2026): at least 90% of breakdowns repaired within 14 days, in line with the 18 days of downtime a year that the 347-day ceiling allows (tools/call_outcomes.py).

approvals.note: The approval backlog counts submitted works records in the last window_days that carry no approval.

form_snapshot.note: The build fails rather than publishes once the snapshot of the live mWater form designs is older than this.

calendar.note: A point-year enters the calendar stratum only with at least this many observed days on its sheet.

piped.note: The piped water-quality figures (tools/rebuild_piped_wq.py). Which systems are managed is data/piped_systems_status.json, not a rule here: a piped system joins the managed portfolio only when its rehabilitation works are complete and its post-rehabilitation water-quality tests are done (Adriaan Mol, 25 Sep 2026). A result dated on or before a system's works completion is baseline and never counts toward a managed figure.

dispensing_events.note: The Curtech dispensing-events extract (act-enduro-feed), once the build writes it. A system admitted by decision takes its operational date from the first dispense on one of its devices that is not a test: test shopkeepers and test cards are excluded. Until the extract exists, the recorded date in data/piped_systems_status.json stands.

pairing.note: Pairing a piped result with its sample (tools/rebuild_piped_wq.py; Adriaan Mol, 28 Sep 2026). A result pairs with the most recent unpaired sample at the same water point taken within window_hours before the result was submitted. Results and samples submitted before protocol_live are pre-project baseline: not paired, flagged or counted.

actions.note: The action list's 'Needs a nudge' line: evidence and manual items past their date, or undated and on the list for longer than this.
actions.no_chasers_note: Curtech tasks: Ralf van Veenendaal's work, tracked by Coddy Velonizy; never in the overdue count, the nudge list or the ticked-without-evidence list (Adriaan Mol, 7 Oct 2026).

changes.note: Rule of 7 Oct 2026 (tools/change_review.py): a week-on-week move of more than this share of tCO2e, water points in scope or people served, carried by edited or deleted mWater records, is provisional until Adriaan or Jan approves.
